messages:
marta: Quick update — ran full sweep across Llama-3b, Qwen-7b, and Mixtral-3 on the new kernel selector. Found a regression on Llama when RoPE scale > 1.2.

devin: Can you paste the perf numbers?

marta: TL;DR: throughput -18% p95-latency +27% at ctx=8192, bsz=4. Only shows up with rotary_scale=1.25 and head_kv mismatch config.

bench-bot: Automated run finished: model=Llama-3b, ctx=8192, batch=4, rotary=1.25, kernel=autoselect -> throughput=115 tok/s, p95=420ms

kai: Hmm. That smells like we fell back to generic attention kernels because the fused rotary kernel doesn't support non-square head_kv dims.

samir: Confirmed in profiler: GEMM dominates but attention kernel time doubled. nvprof snippet:
```
Kernel: fused_rotary_attention  time 1.2ms  (expected ~0.6ms)
Kernel: generic_attention      time 2.4ms
GEMM (QK)                     time 48%
Softmax + add                  time 22%
```

marta: Also saw KV cache memory touch increase — larger stride due to head/kvdim packing change. For Qwen and Mixtral it's fine because kv_dims==head_dim.

devin: So root cause: when head_kv != head_dim we don't pick the optimized path. Two options: extend fused kernels to support head_kv != head_dim or add preflight rewrite to reshape kv to supported layout.

kai: Quick hack tested: forcing kernel=v2-fused in selector for Llama-3b with rotary_scale=1.25 improved throughput to 138 tok/s and p95 down to 350ms. But memory increased ~6%.

bench-bot: Run id 20260318-1: model=Llama-3b, kernel=force_v2, batch=4, ctx=8192 => throughput=138 tok/s, p95=345ms

samir: Recommendation: for now add a model-specific selector rule: if model family == 'llama' && rotary_scale != 1.0 && head_kv != head_dim then prefer 'force_v2'. File: configs/runtime/selectors/per_model_rules.yaml

marta: Also push a follow-up task to engineering: extend fused_rotary to handle kv packing. Ticket: RINF-4623

devin: I'll add a canary rollout: selector rule behind feature flag + telemetry for memory and tail latency. If regressions appear we back out.

marta: Thanks — next steps: 1) add rule in selector, 2) run long ctx stress on dedicated cluster, 3) open kernel extension PR. Will post results here.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: flag=llama-rope-kv-fix starts in 1 hour :rocket:

kai: FYI I attached perf plots to the ticket (p95/throughput/mem). Will share links after upload.
